title: Davidic Promise Layers
purpose: Separate immediate royal meaning, historical development, and Christian canonical fulfilment.
body_markdown:
# Davidic Promise Layers

## Layer 1 - Immediate text

- Offspring
- Father and son
- Discipline
- House, kingdom, throne

## Layer 2 - Royal line

How did later kings continue and fail?

## Layer 3 - Exile crisis

Why did the fall of the monarchy create a question about forever?

## Layer 4 - New Testament synthesis

Read Luke 1:30-33. What claim is made about Jesus?

## Guardrail

Do not turn a modern political leader into a messianic fulfilment.
